branches.name: Observe
branches.path: Semantic vectors → fault observers → belief-state control
branches.gate: Compare observability and calibration with lexical and supervised baselines.

branches.name: Constrain
branches.path: State → legal action grammar → verified transition
branches.gate: Measure strategy regret separately from legal-move rate.

branches.name: Search
branches.path: Candidate trees → whole-path scoring → shared-prefix replay
branches.gate: Account for EOS, tokenization and unmeasured residual language mass.

branches.name: Shape
branches.path: Cold support → heat → exploration → feedback
branches.gate: Move selection to GPU without changing same-tensor probabilities.

branches.name: Rewrite
branches.path: Authoritative state → new prompt → cache-aware re-prefill
branches.gate: Instrument prefix reuse and recurrent-state correctness; no arbitrary KV edit claim.

branches.name: Inspect
branches.path: Information gain → targeted observation → updated belief
branches.gate: Learn observation likelihoods and compare cost-sensitive policies.

branches.name: Reconstruct
branches.path: Immutable blocks → weighted edges → admissible graph
branches.gate: Preserve alternatives; test global structure against labeled source documents.

branches.name: Optimize
branches.path: Semantics → hard checks → Pareto search
branches.gate: Evaluate actual rendered outputs with independent human or visual judgments.

branches.name: Compress
branches.path: Probe vectors → retrieval keys → semantic monitoring
branches.gate: Measure loss of sufficient state and drift rather than assuming a perfect embedding.

branches.name: Explore odd uses
branches.path: Music rules · robot plans · circuit sketches · proof tactics
branches.gate: Choose a checkable domain; separate grammar validity from physics, truth or usefulness.

branches.name: Accelerate
branches.path: GPU score gather → prefix sharing → batching → adaptive MTP
branches.gate: Measure bytes, arithmetic, verified output and quality under equal budgets.

branches.name: Steer mid-generation
branches.path: Acknowledge token → new grammar → rollback uncommitted drafts
branches.gate: Specify committed-prefix boundaries, stale commands, cancellation and replay before coding.

branches.name: Musical tension
branches.path: Meter and key → legal notes → controlled surprise
branches.gate: Prove the verifier and define a fixed budget before asking the model to optimize it.

protocol.Hypothesis: Grammar can keep a melody playable while a sampler explores locally unusual continuations.
protocol.Intervention: Inject bar position and harmonic state each beat. Compare cold Min-P then heat with XTC. Keep the same legal-note set.
protocol.Baseline: A Markov melody generator and random legal notes under the same timing rules.
protocol.Measurement: Blind listening preference, repetition, rule violations and native milliseconds per bar. Raw token surprise stays separate from musical novelty.
protocol.Failure: Tokenization makes note probabilities incomparable, or higher surprise only creates worse music.

branches.name: Proof tactic budget
branches.path: Proof state → type-valid tactics → checked progress
branches.gate: Prove the verifier and define a fixed budget before asking the model to optimize it.

protocol.Hypothesis: A weak proposal distribution may still help a strong proof checker search efficiently.
protocol.Intervention: Generate only registered tactic names; let a sandboxed prover reject invalid applications. Replace stale goals with the current proof state after each accepted step.
protocol.Baseline: Uniform tactic search, fixed heuristics and unconstrained generation at the same checker-call budget.
protocol.Measurement: Solved held-out theorems, verifier calls, time and rollback count. A high path score is not a proof.
protocol.Failure: The grammar covers syntax but excludes a necessary tactic, or scoring costs more than search saves.

branches.name: Compiler treasure hunt
branches.path: Typed rewrite → equivalence check → measured speed
branches.gate: Prove the verifier and define a fixed budget before asking the model to optimize it.

protocol.Hypothesis: Semantic guidance might find rare useful rewrites in a large but checkable neighborhood.
protocol.Intervention: GBNF admits a small rewrite language. Compare Min-P exploration and XTC candidates; verify equivalence before benchmarking.
protocol.Baseline: Compiler defaults, enumerative peephole search and random legal rewrites.
protocol.Measurement: Held-out runtime, compile time, verifier failures and quality per generated token. Control warmup and measurement noise.
protocol.Failure: A benchmark artifact looks like a speedup, or a legal rewrite breaks semantics.

branches.name: Circuit sketches
branches.path: Topology grammar → simulator → robust design search
branches.gate: Prove the verifier and define a fixed budget before asking the model to optimize it.

protocol.Hypothesis: Language priors could prioritize useful circuit motifs even when physics is owned by code.
protocol.Intervention: Enumerate safe simulated component choices. Inject operating points and tolerance results; score whole candidate paths before expensive simulations.
protocol.Baseline: Random legal circuits, Bayesian optimization and domain heuristics with identical simulator budgets.
protocol.Measurement: Feasibility, worst-case performance across tolerances, simulation cost and diversity of successful motifs.
protocol.Failure: The language model prefers familiar-looking circuits that systematically fail physics. No physical actuation is part of this proposal.

branches.name: Database choreography
branches.path: Snapshot → permitted transaction → invariant check
branches.gate: Prove the verifier and define a fixed budget before asking the model to optimize it.

protocol.Hypothesis: State-derived grammars may prevent a workflow from issuing commands that are impossible in its current transaction state.
protocol.Intervention: Expose a small transaction DSL, not unrestricted SQL. Replace state after each committed transaction; adversarially inject a stale snapshot.
protocol.Baseline: A deterministic workflow and optimistic concurrency with ordinary retries.
protocol.Measurement: Invariant violations, stale-state refusals, retries and completion cost under injected conflicts.
protocol.Failure: The grammar encodes an old world. Database concurrency control still owns correctness.

branches.name: Belief camouflage
branches.path: Same world → different wording → invariant controller
branches.gate: Prove the verifier and define a fixed budget before asking the model to optimize it.

protocol.Hypothesis: A useful semantic observer should preserve action decisions under irrelevant paraphrase.
protocol.Intervention: Keep hidden simulator state fixed while varying narrative, label order and distractors. Use probe vectors as features; measure drift before changing the controller.
protocol.Baseline: Direct structured state, lexical rules and a supervised observer.
protocol.Measurement: Vector drift, action invariance, proper scoring rules and closed-loop regret on held-out paraphrases.
protocol.Failure: The controller follows wording rather than state; correlated probes give the illusion of redundant evidence.

branches.name: Adversarial grammar
branches.path: Allowed does not mean wise → find the weakest legal action
branches.gate: Prove the verifier and define a fixed budget before asking the model to optimize it.

protocol.Hypothesis: Grammar can make an application syntactically robust while concentrating every error on a small set of legal but bad actions.
protocol.Intervention: Search state descriptions that maximize oracle regret inside a fixed legal set. Replay the exact winning counterexample across sampler orders.
protocol.Baseline: Random perturbations, a deterministic policy and unconstrained generation at equal query counts.
protocol.Measurement: Legal rate, strategy regret, constraint exhaustion, recovery time and failure diversity.
protocol.Failure: Only easy syntax errors were measured; the evaluation never tested meaningful state mistakes.

branches.name: Token economy
branches.path: Look ahead, ask, or act → allocate a finite inference budget
branches.gate: Prove the verifier and define a fixed budget before asking the model to optimize it.

protocol.Hypothesis: A controller could spend extra scoring calls only where their expected decision benefit exceeds their measured cost.
protocol.Intervention: Use an explicit abstain/inspect/act policy; price prefill, scoring, verification and context rewrite separately. Sweep budgets instead of picking one favorable point.
protocol.Baseline: Always act, always inspect and fixed-depth search with the same end-to-end budget.
protocol.Measurement: Outcome quality versus wall time, energy assumptions, verified tokens and discarded drafts. A decision frontier needs real outcomes.
protocol.Failure: Confidence is mistaken for calibrated value of information, or observer overhead consumes the saved latency.

result.semantics: An explicit experiment tree, not a claim to exhaust every application or to have achieved the proposed optimizations.
